name: Yi-Lightning
description: Ultra-fast inference model optimized for speed without sacrificing quality.
longDescription: Yi-Lightning is 01.AI's speed-optimized model, designed for ultra-fast inference while maintaining strong performance on reasoning and code tasks. It achieves competitive benchmark scores at a fraction of the latency of larger models, making it ideal for real-time applications.
strengths: Strong performance for its latency class
limitations: Less capable than larger Yi models

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.lingyiwanwu.com/v1",
    api_key="YOUR_YI_API_KEY"
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="yi-lightning",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
